title: A spectrum from 0 to 100
text: Every round shows a scale with two opposites, like Cold at 0 and Hot at 100. For example, an ice cube is around 10, lukewarm soup is 50, and a bonfire is 90.

title: One DJ gets the secret number
text: Only the DJ's phone sees where the hidden target sits on the scale, such as 72 out of 100. Everyone else only sees the two ends.

title: Give a real-world clue
text: The DJ writes a clue that sits at that exact spot—without saying any numbers. For 72 on Cold to Hot, a great clue is a fresh cup of coffee.

title: Guess, talk it over, and reveal
text: Everyone locks in a number on their phone. Then all needles appear on the TV so you can debate and adjust before revealing the target. Closer guesses win up to 4 points, and the DJ scores the group's average!
